data.name: Fedora (proot)
data.note: Bootstraps a minimal Fedora root filesystem under proot and installs a 'startfedora' launcher. Downloads the image from a third-party GitLab mirror (not VictorSuite-hosted) — verify you trust that mirror before running.

data.name: Kali NetHunter Rootless
data.note: Runs Kali's own official NetHunter Rootless installer (no root required). Requires the NetHunter-Store app, NetHunter-KeX client and Hacker's Keyboard to be installed from the Play/NetHunter store first — see kali.org/docs/nethunter/nethunter-rootless.

data.name: BlackArch (proot)
data.note: Installs Arch Linux via Termux's official proot-distro, then downloads BlackArch's official strap.sh to layer BlackArch on top. Not an official BlackArch/Termux combination — the script pauses so you can verify strap.sh's checksum against blackarch.org before it is run.

msg: Scripts are reviewed and version-controlled in this repo before publishing.
